description: This file is a Perl module implementing migration functions for different SVN layout versions within a git-svn integration context. It contains various subroutines for migrating repository layouts, managing SVN remotes, and performing repository-specific updates.

methods.name: migrate_from_v0
methods.description: Migrates repository references from v0 layout to v1 layout by renaming refs based on info from 'info/url' files.

methods.name: migrate_from_v1
methods.description: Handles migration of old git-svn v1 layout to the new layout, copying info files and restructuring directories as needed.

methods.name: read_old_urls
methods.description: Recursively reads URL info from existing SVN layout directories to build a mapping of reference IDs to URLs.

methods.name: migrate_from_v2
methods.description: Migrates repository configurations from v2 to the current layout using the git config and svn info data.

methods.name: minimize_connections
methods.description: Optimizes SVN remote layer connections by collapsing multiple remotes into a root SVN connection.

methods.name: migration_check
methods.description: Performs sequential migration steps for multiple SVN layout versions and optionally minimizes SVN remote connections.
